;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Northern Rakhine State clashes]]
**[[Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army|ARSA]] insurgents, using small arms and homemade [[land mine]]s, ambush a Burmese military convoy in the village of Turaing. Three members of Myanmar's security forces are reportedly wounded. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-42595275 (BBC)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/jan/07/rohingya-insurgents-say-they-have-no-option-but-to-fight-myanmar (''The Guardian'')]

;Arts and culture
*[[Donald Trump on social media]]
**[[Twitter]], in response to criticism over its handling of [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s account, says it will not block world leaders or remove their controversial tweets. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-twitter-trump/twitter-says-world-leaders-like-trump-have-special-status-idUSKBN1EU23K (Reuters)]
*[[Weinstein effect]]
**Four women accuse film and television producer, director, and writer [[Paul Haggis]] (''[[Crash (2004 film)|Crash]]'' and ''[[Million Dollar Baby]]'') of sexual misconduct including two rapes. [https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/four-women-accuse-paul-haggis-sexual-misconduct-including-two-rapes-1072015 (''Hollywood Reporter'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Luxor hot air balloon crash]]
**A [[hot air balloon]] crashes due to strong winds in [[Egypt]]'s [[Luxor Governorate]]. A tourist from [[Australia]] is killed and 12 other tourists are injured. The Egypt Aviation Authority says there were 20 passengers on the balloon. [http://www.cnn.com/2018/01/05/middleeast/balloon-crash-egypt/index.html (CNN)]

;International relations
*[[Accession of Turkey to the European Union]]
**[[President of Turkey|Turkish President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] says he is "tired" of waiting for the [[European Union]] to approve Turkey's membership in the political union. [http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/01/erdogan-turkey-tired-eu-membership-process-180105213814481.html (Al Jazeera)]
**[[President of France|French President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] suggests that Turkey could have a "partnership" with the EU instead of full membership. [http://www.france24.com/en/20180105-french-president-macron-suggests-partnership-deal-turkey-eu-not-membership-erdogan (France 24)]
*[[Palestine–United States relations]]
**An anonymous [[United States Department of State|U.S. State Department official]] says no decision has been made on the scheduled January 1, 2018, $125-million payment to the [[UNRWA]] (United Nations Relief and Works Agency), which administers aid for  [[Palestinian people|Palestinian]] refugees. Media reports had stated the money was frozen. The official added the government is still reviewing U.S. assistance to the [[Palestinian National Authority|Palestinian Authority]] and has until January 15 to resolve the issue. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-usa/u-s-official-denies-that-funds-for-palestinian-refugees-frozen-idUSKBN1EU1ZN (Reuters)] [http://thehill.com/homenews/administration/367674-us-freezes-payment-to-un-agency-for-palestinian-refugees-report (''The Hill'')]
*[[Belgium–Netherlands relations]]
**[[Belgium]] and the [[Netherlands]], by swapping 48 acres of land, agree that one section of their border is now the center of the [[Meuse|Meuse River]]. This is expected to fix a police jurisdiction problem. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2018/01/05/Belgium-Netherlands-change-their-mutual-border-in-48-acre-land-swap/9271515174185/ (UPI)] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/belgium-netherlands-national-border-change-meuse-vise-eijsden-maastricht-a8141166.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[Foreign relations of Iran]]
**During a session of the [[United Nations Security Council]], the [[United States]] repeat its "unapologetic" support for the ongoing [[2017–18 Iranian protests|Iranian protests]]. Russia denounces the "veiled [U.S.] attempt to use the current moment to continue to undermine" the [[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action|JCPOA]]. [[France]] calls to "be wary of any attempt to exploit this crisis for personal ends". [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/01/05/world/middleeast/un-iran-protests-debate.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections]]
**[[United States Senate|Senators]] [[Chuck Grassley]] and [[Lindsey Graham]] of the [[United States Senate Committee on the Judiciary]] refer the British spy [[Christopher Steele]] to the [[U.S. Department of Justice]] for a potential criminal investigation. [http://abcnews.go.com/Politics/wireStory/senators-make-criminal-referral-dossier-author-doj-52166564 (ABC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of the United States]]
**[[Director of the National Security Agency|National Security Agency director]] [[Admiral (United States)|Admiral]] [[Michael S. Rogers|Mike Rogers]] plans to retire this spring. President Donald Trump is expected to nominate a successor later this month.  [https://www.politico.com/story/2018/01/05/nsa-mike-rogers-to-retire-267634 (Politico)] [http://nymag.com/daily/intelligencer/2018/01/nsa-chief-mike-rogerss-classified-retirement-memo-leaks.html (''New York Magazine'')]

;Science and technology
*[[Ozone depletion]]
**[[NASA]] research, published in ''[[Geophysical Research Letters]]'', implies that the [[Ozone layer#Depletion|ozone layer]] is starting to recover due to man's actions. The decline in ozone-depleting chemicals, specifically [[chlorine]] from [[chlorofluorocarbon]] (an effect from the 1980's [[Montreal Protocol|CFC ban]], say the scientists), has resulted in 20 percent less depletion since 2005. [http://www.newsweek.com/nasa-hole-earths-ozone-layer-finally-closing-humans-did-something-771922 (''Newsweek'')]
*Six-time U.S. [[NASA astronaut]] [[John Young (astronaut)|John Young]] dies at the age of 87. He was the [[List of Apollo astronauts#Apollo astronauts who walked on the Moon|9th man who walked]] on the [[Moon]]. [http://amp.timeinc.net/fortune/2018/01/06/astronaut-john-young-dead (''Time Magazine'')]
